subject: Re: ASPEST status: repro complete on all six benchmarks, coverage-target risk
body:
All,

Closing decisions ahead of the LRB slot:

1. The pilot eval report shipped July 23, a day early. The coverage-as-SLA framing survived contact with the pilot customer - they picked 88% coverage off the measured amazon_review-style risk curve rather than demanding 95%, which tells me the design does its job. Halima's routing-layer integration doc is the artifact I'll reuse for every future engagement.

2. Scope cut for v1: we ship with four benchmarks in the standard eval battery (mnist->svhn, cifar10->cinic10, amazon_review, otto). fmow and domainnet stay in the extended suite - their build times are too long for the per-engagement loop.

3. Nadia - requesting the August 6 board. Materials: eval report, coverage-SLA design, and the abstention demo. Nothing customer-facing before sign-off, per process.

Strong quarter, this one turned out exactly like the kickoff pitch said it would, which never happens.

Dmitri
